en: n. a thin soft paper used for wiping your nose; a group of cells in a plant or animal that are alike and do the same job; very thin soft cloth
ex: She pulled a tissue from the box and blew her nose.
她從盒子裡抽出一張面紙擤鼻涕。

en: a. able to be trusted or depended on; working well and consistently
ex: He is a reliable worker who is never late.
他是個可靠的員工，從不遲到。

en: n. a feeling of comfort when something unpleasant has stopped or has not happened; the removal of pain or worry; help given to people in need; a raised design on a surface; a person who takes over a job from another
ex: It was a great relief to hear that she was safe.
聽說她平安無事，真是令人鬆了一口氣。

en: n. an exciting and sometimes dangerous experience; the excitement of doing something new and different; v. to take part in an exciting and dangerous activity
ex: Their trip around the world was a great adventure.
他們的環球之旅是一次精彩的冒險。

en: conj. every time that; at any time when; adv. (informal) at any time (used in questions)
ex: Come and visit us whenever you like.
你隨時想來看我們都可以。

en: a long narrow piece of cloth worn around the neck under a shirt collar, mainly by men
ex: He put on a necktie for the job interview.
他戴上領帶去參加工作面試。

en: a type of grass that is grown for its grain, from which flour is made
ex: The farmers harvest wheat in early summer.
農夫們在初夏收割小麥。

en: n. a single thing that is part of a larger group; a group of people who work together; a standard amount used for measuring; a machine or piece of equipment with a particular purpose; a. relating to a single thing
ex: One meter is a unit of length.
一公尺是長度單位。

en: n. a room where an artist, photographer or musician works; a place where films or TV or radio programs are made; a small apartment
ex: The artist spends all day in her studio painting.
那位藝術家整天待在她的畫室裡作畫。

en: n. scientific knowledge used in practical ways in industry; machines, equipment and methods that use this knowledge; the study of such knowledge
ex: Modern technology has changed the way we communicate.
現代科技改變了我們的溝通方式。

en: n. the amount of sound that something produces; the amount of space an object contains; a large amount of something; a book, especially one of a series; v. to roll something into a tube
ex: Please turn down the volume of the TV.
請把電視音量調小。

en: v. to leave a job, school or position; to stop doing something; to leave a place; n. (rare) the act of leaving
ex: He decided to quit his job and travel around the world.
他決定辭掉工作，環遊世界。

en: v. to become healthy again, or to make someone or something healthy again; (of a wound) to close and recover; to put right a difficult situation
ex: The cut on my finger took a week to heal.
我手指上的傷口花了一週才癒合。

en: to make something shorter or less long; to become shorter
ex: The tailor will shorten the sleeves of this jacket.
裁縫會把這件外套的袖子改短。

en: v. to force liquid or food out of your mouth; (informal) to say something in an angry way; n. liquid in the mouth; a long thin stick for holding meat over a fire; a narrow piece of land that sticks out into the sea
ex: It is rude to spit in public.
在公共場所吐口水很不禮貌。

en: a large round fruit with a hard green skin, red juicy flesh and black seeds
ex: We shared a big watermelon on the hot afternoon.
在炎熱的午後，我們一起分食了一顆大西瓜。

en: a. causing pain or suffering to someone deliberately; showing no kindness or sympathy; causing great suffering
ex: It was cruel to leave the dog outside in the cold.
把狗留在寒冷的室外太殘忍了。

en: n. an act of risking money on the result of a game or race; an action that has a risk of failing; v. to bet money on the result of a game; to take a risk hoping for success
ex: He lost all his savings in a gamble on the stock market.
他把積蓄都賭在股市上，結果全賠光了。

en: v. to allow someone to do something or make something possible; n. an official document that allows you to do something
ex: You need a permit to park in this area.
你需要許可證才能在這一區停車。

en: n. a vehicle with two wheels pulled by a horse; a small vehicle pushed by hand; a shopping trolley; v. to carry something in a cart; to carry something awkwardly
ex: The farmer loaded the vegetables onto a cart.
農夫把蔬菜裝上推車。
ph: put the cart before the horse

en: a. covered with grass; green like grass; looking or tasting like grass
ex: We sat on the grassy slope and enjoyed the view.
我們坐在長滿草的斜坡上欣賞風景。

en: n. a place or position; a place where a film or TV program is made away from a studio; the act of finding or fixing the position of something
ex: The hotel is in a great location near the beach.
這家飯店位置絕佳，離海灘很近。

en: a. relating to or found in the hottest parts of the world, near the equator; very hot and humid; (of a feeling) very warm
ex: Many tropical fruits grow in Southeast Asia.
許多熱帶水果生長在東南亞。

en: all human beings considered as a group; (old use) men considered as separate from women
ex: Pollution is a threat to all of mankind.
汙染是對全人類的威脅。

en: a. not mixed with anything else; completely clean and free from harmful substances; complete and total; morally good and innocent
ex: This bottle of juice is made from pure orange.
這瓶果汁是用純橙子做的。

en: v. to repair something that is broken or torn; to become healthy again; to improve a bad situation; n. a place where something has been repaired
ex: She sat by the window and mended her son's torn trousers.
她坐在窗邊，修補兒子破掉的長褲。

en: n. the quality of being warm; friendly and kind feelings; enthusiasm or excitement
ex: We sat by the fire and enjoyed its warmth.
我們坐在火邊享受它的溫暖。

en: n. the process of gaining knowledge; knowledge gained by study; deep knowledge of a subject
ex: Learning a new language takes time and effort.
學習一門新語言需要時間和努力。

en: a. moving or happening very quickly; done without delay; n. a small bird like a swallow that flies fast
ex: The swift current carried the boat downstream.
湍急的水流把小船帶向下游。

en: n. a statement that explains the meaning of a word or phrase; the clearness of an image or sound; a statement of what something is
ex: Can you give me a definition of this word?
你可以給我這個字的定義嗎？

en: n. a thick piece of soft material used to protect or shape something; a number of sheets of paper fastened together; a flat place for helicopters to land; (informal) a person's home; v. to fill or cover something with soft material; to walk softly
ex: He wrote down the phone number on a notepad.
他把電話號碼寫在便條紙上。

en: a person who votes or has the right to vote in an election
ex: Many young voters did not turn out for the election.
許多年輕選民沒有去投票。

en: a. not available in large enough amounts to satisfy demand; rare or hard to find
ex: Fresh water is becoming scarce in many parts of the world.
世界上許多地區的淡水正變得稀缺。

en: n. a small electric light that you carry in your hand; (BrE: torch) a light that you hold; a flash that is used to send signals
ex: I used a flashlight to find my way in the dark.
我用手電筒在黑暗中找路。

en: n. a machine in a tall building that takes people up and down; a machine for lifting things; a grain storage building; (BrE: lift)
ex: Take the elevator to the tenth floor.
搭電梯到十樓。

en: n. a strong wish to achieve something, especially success or power; the thing that you want to achieve; the desire to be successful
ex: His ambition is to become a famous doctor.
他的志向是成為一名著名的醫生。

en: v. to tell someone about something, officially or formally; to give someone information; to tell the police about a crime; to inform on someone
ex: Please inform me as soon as the package arrives.
包裹一到請馬上通知我。

en: n. a formal set of ideas that is intended to explain something; the ideas that a subject is based on; an opinion or idea that someone has
ex: Einstein's theory changed the way we understand time and space.
愛因斯坦的理論改變了我們對時間與空間的理解。

en: v. to refuse to accept something and try to stop it from happening; to fight against something; to stop yourself from doing something that you want to do; n. a substance used to protect something from a chemical
ex: I couldn't resist eating another piece of the cake.
我忍不住又多吃了一塊蛋糕。

en: n. a small round piece of medicine that you swallow; a small ball of something; (old) a bad or unpleasant person; v. to form into pills
ex: Take one pill after each meal.
每餐飯後吃一顆藥丸。
